That is a lab-browser limit — not a Birkly failure. Birkly still injects the tools script, stamps toolname/toantiguoescription on allowlisted forms, and registers tools in browsers that do support WebMCP. Verify locally with the steps below. The separate llms.txt check needs /llms.txt on your site (served automatically from a published Agent Guide).

admin.ag_tools_verify_step3: In DevHerramientas → Lighthouse, run Agentic Browsing (or check the model-context inspector) to see the registered tools.
